description: The closed set of model ids the REVIEW capability may resolve to on a model-id provider. Policy, fabric-coordinator's (policies/AUTHORITY.md): the reviewer's model is chosen here, deliberately, never by a profile layer on its own; a project's architecture role proposes, the coordinator lands. tools/fabric/lint.py refuses a committed profile whose merged review model is outside this set, and runtime/openrouter/launch refuses the MERGED result at launch (the local override layer is where an unreviewed model would otherwise sneak in). Coding classes — code-low, code-medium, code-high, code-plan — are not gated by this file. Decision 2026-09-13 (the owner, holding architect-cto; landed by fabric-coordinator): z-ai/glm-5.3 is admitted and is the default review model on the broker path; Opus 5 stays admitted for a profile that wants it. Add a router or preset here only after a live test has shown the harness forwards that reference verbatim.
